theme: Set crease angles to fold a target 3D shape
title: Fold-Chain Inverse Kinematics
strategies: flat baseline: leave every crease angle at 0 (do not fold at all)
per-crease independent aiming: fit each crease's angle in isolation to point its own downstream corner at the nearest target, ignoring the other creases meeting at the same vertex

constraint-manifold search: parametrize each vertex flower by its single true kinematic degree of freedom, Newton-solve the other three crease angles so the loop-closure equation holds exactly for every candidate, then search the resulting 1-D feasible curve for the best target match
global joint optimization: coordinate-descend over all flowers' free parameters and bridge angles simultaneously instead of the front-to-back sequential pass
